label: Outweighed reason: weighs more in one respect, worse overall, and not favoured
definition: Outweighed w good φ s r x y: at scenario s, respect r weighs y above x (w s r x < w s r y, with w s r z the graded weight of candidate z in respect r), yet overall x is better than y (good s x y) and the profile φ favours x over y. Respect weights and overall betterness are parameters, read as value; no aggregation rule is typed in general (the control uses the sum). Example: a plan better for one recipient and worse overall, passed over. Non-example: a respect in which the favoured candidate also weighs more.
